grades: Current high school juniors (rising seniors), no exceptions
pay_detail: Tuition $5,000 including room and board. Up to $100,000 in financial aid and scholarships is available. $55 application fee.
name: Medill Cherubs Journalism Institute
org: Northwestern University, Medill School of Journalism
what_you_do: Spend 4 weeks on the Northwestern campus learning to report, write and produce news. Work with journalism faculty and professionals.
who_can_apply: Current high school juniors who will be seniors in fall 2027. The page says no exceptions.
deadline_text: No applications before December 1, 2026. All materials are due by noon Central on March 1, 2027. Decisions by March 24, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application form, write a 200 to 225 word essay, list your journalism activities and send up to three work samples. Pay the $55 fee. Your counselor emails your transcript, GPA and school profile to Prof. Roger Boye. Add the financial aid form and a parent tax return if you want aid.
